notes.title: You're now a Docent
notes.text: We now guess your reaction right 63% of the time. Don't let it go to your head. Or ours. Your latest Love was The Bridge 1096 by Painter 8. Bold choice. We respect it. Geographically, your eye keeps landing in Netherlands. Passport not required. Next, try Hudson River School. Worst case, you'll have something new to pass on.

notes.title: Where your taste stands
notes.text: Remember Impressionism? Lately you've moved on to Renaissance. Impressionism is taking it well. Show you oranges & ochres and you melt a little. Met artist 5 keeps getting your approval. It may be time to admit you have a favorite. Next, try Ming dynasty China. Worst case, you'll have something new to pass on.

notes.title: A note on your looking
notes.text: When you explain a Love, you most often point to light and color. Symbolism draws you in, while Ukiyo-e rarely does. That's a useful contrast to keep in mind as you look. Symbolism is the movement you respond to most so far, across 2 works. Consider giving Ukiyo-e another look; you may find one that changes your mind.
